description: Presidential Secretariat - Enlarge the time frame up to 28.02.2022 of the Special Presidential Commission
categorisation: This gazette content involves the extension of time for a Presidential Commission of Inquiry to submit its final report, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It references specific sections of the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393) and previous gazette notifications, making it primarily about legal procedures and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
